detail:
- **Documented**: 87 of 219 modules carry an author's summary

32 requirements: 20 checked and 12 refuted.
label: src
quotes: The App module is the top level React entry component that wires together and renders the design system for preview, exporting a single App operation with no recorded internal call relationships or requirements yet.
The data of a chart as a table only screen readers see: the drawing is decorative, this is what they read.
The key of a chart: a swatch and a name per series.
Provides scale construction logic used to map data values to visual coordinates for chart organisms like dumbbell, heatmap, line, and scatter charts.
The tone of the i-th series when it has none: the first in ink, the rest in gray.
Writes a figure the Spanish way ("1.234,5"), with a fixed number of decimals and a unit after it.
Bullets are the dots that say which page a paginated strip is on, and jump to it.
Button is the atomic UI component providing the library's standard clickable button element.
Count is a figure that counts up from zero when it comes into view (or its Step lights up), in 1.4 s, with the Spanish number format.
Logo is the 540 logotype: the star and the word, one block.
MenuItem is a destination of the menu: a real link with a "current section" state.

rows.label: foundations
rows.summary: 10 modules. `Breakpoints` — The three ranges and the two breakpoints. `ColorPrimitives` — All primitive colors, grouped by family. (and 7 more documented)

rows.label: hooks
rows.summary: 2 modules. `useCenterState` — A React hook that determines a timeline entry's temporal state relative to a scroll or center reference point. `useReveal` — Whether a piece should show its final state: it is on screen (a third of it, at least) and its Step, if any, is on.

rows.label: render
rows.summary: 1 module. `setup` — The Render module provides the app's render setup entry point used to initialize rendering for the library.

rows.label: runtime
rows.summary: 4 modules in 1 group. `client` — The client module hydrates island components in the browser, using a marker on DOM elements to avoid re-hydrating them and relying on React to render content into slots. `react` — Runs a hydrate call; components rendered inside it read the server snapshot of external stores. (and 2 more documented)

rows.summary: 2 modules in 1 group. `TalkTemplate` — TalkTemplate is a full-page layout component that arranges a talk piece's slides and steps into a finished themed presentation, consuming StepsContext for navigation state and accepting a default theme via its props.
